messages.subject: Half degree grid
parts:
Hi,

as I understand it is possible to create maps with a half degree grid (like the Köppen Map in the paper). Is it possible to retrieve an excelfile (or something that I can convert into an excelfile) that in three columns gives me the longitude, laditute and countrycode or name for each half grid?

Regards,
Patricia

messages.author: 81b6b3d7dfea88a5
messages.subject: Re: [rworldmap group] Half degree grid
parts:
Thanks Patricia,
This should do what you ask.
Best wishes,
Andy

library(rworldmap)
#this is a grid with the UN numeric country code in each half degree cell
data(gridCountriesNumeric)

#convert the SpatialGridDataFrame to a dataframe of z,x,y
dF <- as.data.frame(gridCountriesNumeric)

#simple plot to check it looks about right
plot(dF$s1,dF$s2,col=dF$country.asc)

#output to a csv
write.csv(dF,"countryCodeGrid.csv",row.names=FALSE)
